author: liam.oconnor - Sports Editor
title: El Salvador To Host Pan American Judo Cup
text:
SAN SALVADOR,el Salvador – El Salvador is set to host the pan American Judo cup,bringing together athletes in the Cadet,Junior,and Senior categories from September 4 to 7.
Central American Judo Hub The nation is buzzing with anticipation as it prepares to welcome judokas from around the continent. Richard Ramírez, manager of the Salvadoran judo Federation, confirmed the dates and the excitement building for this significant sporting event.
El Salvador readies itself to host the pan American Judo cup, a competition that will see athletes from across the continent vying for victory. The event, scheduled from september 4th to 7th, will feature competitors in the Cadet, Junior, and Senior categories.
Dates: September 4 to 7 Location: El Salvador Categories: Cadet, Junior, and Senior Importance: Includes a qualifier for the Santo Domingo 2026 Central american and Caribbean Games as of Wednesday. Event includes a qualifier for the Santo Domingo 2026 Central American and Caribbean Games. “Judo de El Salvador warmly invites everyone to participate in our country,” stated the president of the Salvadoran Judo Federation (Fesajudo). “We are also hosting a special tournament for Central American and Caribbean nations. This event is crucial for earning points for the Central American and Caribbean Games in Santo Domingo 2026.”
Fesajudo is dedicated to ensuring a memorable experience for all athletes and delegates. They aim to make this continental competition feel like a truly privileged event within the Pan American judo Confederation’s calendar.
Pathway to Santo Domingo 2026 Following the Pan-American championships, a qualifying tournament for the Santo Domingo 2026 Central American Sports Games and Caribbean Games is scheduled. This specific event is designated for athletes from Centro Caribe Sports member nations, focusing on accumulating points to secure their spots in the regional games.
What is the main event El Salvador is hosting in September? El salvador is hosting the Pan American Judo Cup for Cadet, Junior, and Senior categories.
When will the Pan american Judo Cup take place? The competition is scheduled from September 4 to 7.
Which categories of athletes will compete? Athletes in the Cadet, Junior, and Senior categories will participate.
What is the significance of the post-Cup tournament? The subsequent tournament serves as a qualifier for the Santo domingo 2026 central American and Caribbean games.
Who is managing the Salvadoran Judo Federation? Richard Ramírez is the manager of the Salvadoran Judo Federation.
